domain.name: Ordering
domain.summary: The Ordering domain turns a checked-out cart into a confirmed order. It orchestrates checkout — reserving inventory, authorizing payment and creating the order — and owns the lifecycle of every order.

domain.name: Payments
domain.summary: The Payments domain takes payment for orders and processes refunds. It orchestrates authorization and capture through an external payment processor, and screens payments for fraud.

domain.name: Customer Notifications
domain.summary: The Customer Notifications subdomain keeps customers informed. It listens to key moments across Ordering, Fulfilment, Payments, Reviews, Loyalty and Returns and sends the customer an email, SMS or push notification on their preferred channel.

system.name: Inventory System
system.summary: Internal system that tracks stock and reserves it for orders. It is the source of truth for available inventory and confirms whether stock can be reserved.

system.name: Warehouse System
system.summary: Internal system that picks and packs orders in the warehouse. It reacts to completed orders, organises picking, and signals when an order is packed and ready to ship.

system.name: Shipping System
system.summary: Internal system that hands packed orders to carriers. It reacts to ready-for-shipping orders and creates shipments with an external carrier.

system.name: Carrier
system.summary: External carrier that delivers shipments to customers. It accepts shipment requests and reports delivery progress back.

system.name: Returns System
system.summary: Internal system that accepts, approves and tracks customer returns through to their arrival back at the warehouse.

domain.name: Payments
domain.summary: The Payments domain takes payment for orders and processes refunds. It orchestrates authorization and capture through an external payment processor, and screens payments for fraud.

domain.name: Customer Notifications

service.name: Inventory Service
service.summary: The system of record for stock. Reserves and releases inventory, serves stock-level queries, and publishes events when stock is reserved or unavailable.

data.name: Inventory Database
data.summary: PostgreSQL database that is the system of record for stock levels and reservations.

service.name: Warehouse Service
service.summary: Orchestrates picking and packing in the warehouse. It reacts to completed orders, creates picking jobs, and signals when an order is ready to ship.

data.name: Warehouse Database
data.summary: PostgreSQL database that stores picking jobs and their status.

service.name: Picking Worker
service.summary: Works through picking jobs on the warehouse floor and signals when an order has been picked and packed.

service.name: Shipping API
service.summary: Receives ready-for-shipping orders, selects a carrier, and kicks off shipment creation.

service.name: Carrier Adapter
service.summary: Translates Acme Inc shipment requests into the external carrier's format and sends them to create a shipment.

service.name: Shipping API
service.summary: The carrier's API for creating shipments. Acme Inc's Shipping System calls it to dispatch packed orders.

service.name: Tracking API
service.summary: The carrier's API for reporting delivery progress. It notifies Acme Inc when a shipment is created, delivered, or fails.

service.name: Returns API
service.summary: Public API customers use to start a return. Validates the request against the original order and records it.

data.name: Returns Database
data.summary: PostgreSQL database that is the system of record for return requests and their status.

service.name: Returns Processor
service.summary: Applies the returns policy to new requests and tracks returned parcels until they arrive back at the warehouse.
